# Phase 0 — Instagram Saved Replies

*Generated from `keywords.csv`. **Do not edit this file** — edit the CSV and rebuild. 27 replies, all under 600 characters.*

> **Where these go:** Instagram → **Settings → Business tools → Saved replies → +**. Put the shortcut in *Shortcut* and the text in *Message*. Typing the shortcut in any DM expands it.

> **Do the 12 below first.** They cover the seven campaign keywords plus the four questions everyone asks. The other 15 are a ten-minute job for another day — you are not behind if they are not in yet.

> ⚠️ **means a human still needs to follow up.** Send the reply, then message Collins. The automation does this silently later; for now it is you.

## The other 15 — when you have ten spare minutes

### `roi` — Returns / yield / appreciation  ⚠️ *then tell Collins*

```
Good question - and that is one worth having with a person rather than a chat window.

Let me get someone from the team onto it with you. What number is best to reach you on?
```

### `refund` — Refund / cancellation  ⚠️ *then tell Collins*

```
Straight answer, because it matters. On cancellation for any reason, the purchaser forfeits 25% of the agreed purchase price as a cancellation penalty. Refunds are made only after the property is resold to a third party, and the developer has up to 180 days from the date of resale to make any net refund.

That is the written policy. Let me get someone from the team to take you through it - what number works for you?
```

### `bank` — Account details / ready to pay  ⚠️ *then tell Collins*

```
Payments go to IFT Realty Ltd - and I will not put bank information in a chat window, because that is exactly how people get defrauded.

Let me get someone from the team to confirm everything with you directly. What number should they call?
```

## The four FAQs

Instagram → **Settings → Business tools → FAQs**. These show as tappable buttons when someone opens a new chat, so they do the first move for you.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What are the prices? | 4-bed semi-detached ₦185m · 5-bed off-plan ₦200m · 2-bed condominium ₦95m · plots 648 sqm at ₦125,000/sqm. Which one are you looking at? |
| Where is the estate? | Abijo, opposite GRA Second Gate, Ibeju-Lekki — under 5 minutes from the Lekki-Epe Expressway. Want to come and see it? |
| Can I inspect? | Any day of the week, weekends included — representatives are on site. We also do virtual inspections over Zoom or WhatsApp video. What day works for you? |
| What payment plans are there? | Deposit with the balance over 3, 6 or 12 months, and there are campaigns running that open it up further. Which unit are you looking at? |
